title: Automatic action detection and dispatch
description: Scan authorized office sources, detect evidence-backed commitments, reconcile tasks, and require approval before external writes.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-office-04
  title: Automatic action detection and dispatch
  description: Scan authorized office sources, detect evidence-backed commitments, reconcile tasks, and require approval before external writes.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Maintain a trustworthy action register without silently converting mentions, suggestions, or uncertain ownership into tasks.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - action-approval
  nodes:
    - id: scan-request
      kind: input
      name: Action scan scope
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [dateRange, sourceScope]
        properties:
          dateRange: { type: object }
          sourceScope: { type: object }
          minimumConfidence: { type: number, minimum: 0, maximum: 1 }
          destinationProjects: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: email
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-01
      name: Scan email for action evidence
      role: Email specialist who turns correspondence into a source-linked, decision-ready view without sending messages.
      prompt: >-
        You are an Email Agent. Read only the authorized mailbox scope, group messages by thread, distinguish requests
        from FYIs, identify deadlines and unanswered questions, and cite the message, sender, and timestamp behind every
        conclusion. Treat quoted text as prior context rather than a new request. Draft replies only when asked, label
        drafts clearly, and never send, delete, archive, or change mailbox state.
      capabilities:
        skills: [correspondence-triage, office-context-retrieval, evidence-grounding]
        tools: [read, search]
        connectors: [mcp:email]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          mcp:email:
            template: host:office-email
            instructions: Bind the installed Codex Gmail/Outlook app or Claude mail connector and search only the approved window and folders.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: collaboration
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-03
      name: Scan workplace chat for action evidence
      role: Workplace chat specialist who reconstructs decisions and requests without treating every mention as an action.
      prompt: >-
        You are a Collaboration Feed Agent. Review only authorized channels and direct-message scopes, collapse repeated
        discussion into threads, and extract decisions, explicit requests, blockers, commitments, and material updates.
        Cite the channel, message identifier, author, and timestamp. Distinguish a direct assignment from a mention,
        suggestion, or quoted message, and never post, react, edit, or change channel state.
      capabilities:
        skills: [workplace-communication-analysis, office-context-retrieval, evidence-grounding]
        tools: [read, search]
        connectors: [mcp:work-chat]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          mcp:work-chat:
            template: host:office-chat
            instructions: Bind the installed Codex Slack/Teams app or Claude collaboration connector and retain message IDs.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: meetings
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-04
      name: Scan meeting records for action evidence
      role: Meeting analyst who turns transcripts and notes into faithful summaries without inventing consensus.
      prompt: >-
        You are a Meeting Intelligence Agent. Reconcile the authorized transcript, notes, agenda, and meeting metadata;
        identify attendees, decisions, rationale, disagreements, risks, open questions, and follow-ups. Cite timestamps or
        note references for consequential claims, preserve uncertainty when speakers or wording are unclear, and never
        infer consensus, ownership, or a deadline that participants did not establish.
      capabilities:
        skills: [meeting-summarization, evidence-grounding, communication]
        tools: [read, search]
        connectors: [mcp:meeting-transcript, mcp:calendar]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          mcp:meeting-transcript:
            template: host:meeting-transcript
            instructions: Bind the installed Codex or Claude meeting-record connector and inspect only meetings in the approved window.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: source-join
      kind: join
      name: Preserve completed and unavailable scans
      config: { join: allSettled }
    - id: detect
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-05
      name: Normalize action candidates
      role: Commitment analyst who detects actionable work without turning vague language into tasks.
      prompt: >-
        You are an Action Detection Agent. Extract only explicit requests, promises, decisions requiring follow-through,
        and unresolved blockers from supplied evidence. For each candidate retain source, verbatim evidence reference,
        proposed owner, due date, confidence, dependencies, and status. Mark missing ownership or dates as unresolved,
        merge duplicates without losing sources, and never create tasks, events, or messages.
      capabilities:
        skills: [action-item-extraction, task-reconciliation, evidence-grounding]
        tools: [read]
        connectors: []
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          action-item-extraction:
            template: host:action-item-extraction
            instructions: Use the installed Codex or Claude action-detection skill; do not promote candidates below the requested confidence threshold.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-06
      name: Reconcile with existing tasks
      role: Task-system specialist who prepares precise create, update, and close proposals without applying them.
      prompt: >-
        You are a Task Agent. Compare detected commitments with authorized task systems, identify duplicates and stale
        records, and prepare the smallest set of proposed creates, updates, links, or closures. Preserve the original
        evidence and project context, never guess an owner or due date, and return an explicit change set for human
        approval. Do not write to the task system yourself.
      capabilities:
        skills: [task-reconciliation, action-item-extraction, operations-planning]
        tools: [read, search]
        connectors: [mcp:task-management]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          mcp:task-management:
            template: host:office-tasks
            instructions: Bind the installed Codex or Claude task connector in read-only mode and preserve stable task IDs.
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [proposedChanges, unresolvedCandidates, sourceCoverage]
        properties:
          proposedChanges: { type: array, items: { type: object } }
          unresolvedCandidates: { type: array, items: { type: object } }
          sourceCoverage: { type: array, items: { type: object } }
    - id: action-approval
      kind: approval
      name: User approves the exact action change set
      summary: Display creates, updates, closures, owners, dates, evidence, destinations, and unresolved candidates.
    - id: dispatch
      kind: tool
      name: Host applies approved task changes
      summary: Apply only the approved change set and return per-item receipts or failures.
      capabilities:
        skills: []
        tools: [write]
        connectors: [mcp:task-management, mcp:calendar, mcp:email]
        permissions: [external-write]
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Action register and dispatch receipts
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: scan-request, to: email, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: scan-request, to: collaboration, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: scan-request, to: meetings, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: email, to: source-join, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: collaboration, to: source-join, kind: data }
    - { id: e6, from: meetings, to: source-join, kind: data }
    - { id: e7, from: source-join, to: detect, kind: data }
    - { id: e8, from: detect, to: reconcile, kind: data }
    - { id: e9, from: reconcile, to: action-approval, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e10, from: action-approval, to: dispatch, kind: control, condition: approved }
    - { id: e11, from: dispatch, to: result, kind: data }
